name: East Sister Summit, Three Sisters Range, Bowling Green Bay NP​
description:
Image credit - www.wanderstories.space

𝐾𝑖𝑛𝑑 𝑅𝑒𝑚𝑖𝑛𝑑𝑒𝑟 𝐴𝑏𝑜𝑢𝑡 𝑅𝑆𝑉𝑃𝑠:

𝑆𝑒𝑙𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑔 '𝐺𝑜𝑖𝑛𝑔' 𝑜𝑛 𝐹𝑎𝑐𝑒𝑏𝑜𝑜𝑘 𝑑𝑜𝑒𝑠 𝑛𝑜𝑡 𝑐𝑜𝑢𝑛𝑡 𝑎𝑠 𝑎𝑛 𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑖𝑐𝑖𝑎𝑙 𝑅𝑆𝑉𝑃. 𝑇𝑜 𝑒𝑛𝑠𝑢𝑟𝑒 𝑦𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑠𝑝𝑜𝑡 𝑖𝑠 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑓𝑖𝑟𝑚𝑒𝑑, 𝑝𝑙𝑒𝑎𝑠𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑓𝑒𝑟 𝑡𝑜 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑅𝑆𝑉𝑃 𝑠𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑖𝑛 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝑒𝑣𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝑑𝑒𝑠𝑐𝑟𝑖𝑝𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑓𝑜𝑟 𝑡ℎ𝑒 𝐶𝑙𝑢𝑏’𝑠 𝑅𝑆𝑉𝑃 𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑐𝑒𝑠𝑠. 

Leader: Cherry Judge​

We meet at: 6:30 am . Location will be emailed to those that RSVP 

Difficulty Level: Intermediate. On and Off-track. Moderate (AWTGS Grade 3)

Trail Description: really overgrown, uneven underfoot, steep, some clambering over boulders. Likely to go off track every now and again and needing to retrace steps - forewarned is forearmed. 

Distance: Approx. 8 km return
Elevation Gain: 360 m

Duration: Approx. 4-5 hours

Description:
Join us for a picturesque hike to the summit of the East Sister Mountain (442 m), located just south of Townsville near Elliot Springs. The route follows an old, eroded road which, although generally easy-going, may have slippery sections due to loose topsoil, particularly on steeper sections. Expect to encounter areas of lantana and spear grasses along the track.

The walk begins at a gated private property (permission obtained), covering approximately 4 km from the gate to the summit. Once at the top, you'll be rewarded with stunning views over rolling countryside, the Coral Sea, and Mount Elliot. Impressive cliffs add to the scenic beauty and provide excellent photo opportunities.

Participants should come prepared with appropriate footwear, sun protection, plenty of water, and snacks.

What to bring on the walk - https://bit.ly/wtbdayhike

Please Note - This is an exposed walk. Sun protection and plenty of hydration is vital. 

𝐑𝐒𝐕𝐏: 
Places are limited to 10.  
To secure your spot, please email Cherry Judge - info@veteducation.com.au to RSVP.
TBWC Members = Free 
Visitors and Guests - $5 to cover our insurance.

name: Saltwater Gorge Hike
description:
Saltwater Gorge Hike - Saturday 1st March

Location: Clemant State Forest, Townsville, North Queensland, Australia
Distance: 14.5 km return
Elevation Gain: 125 m
Duration: 4–7 hours (depending on the group's abilities)
Grade: Moderate

Join us for an adventurous hike to Saltwater Gorge, a little-known gem within Clemant State Forest. This secluded gorge and waterfall remain well hidden from all but the keenest explorers.

Expect varied terrain, including long grass, slippery rocks, and uneven footing as we make our way through the grasslands. Our journey will take us along remote bush, along rocky creeks, and into a picturesque gorge where we can take a break and enjoy the scenery before returning along the same route.

This is an off-track hike, so a sense of adventure is required. Good fitness is required, as the hike will take anywhere from 4 to 7 hours depending on the group’s pace.

What to Bring:
Sturdy hiking boots 
2–3 litres of water
Snacks and lunch
Sun protection (hat, sunscreen, long sleeves recommended)
Gaiters or long pants (to protect against long grass)
First aid kit and personal medication

Sign-up & Contact:
To join this hike, RSVP by emailing luenwarneke@gmail.com and filling out this form https://forms.gle/G2o5dxrkvnUrRUaB6
Numbers may be limited.
